tasks.FindMaximumElement: Find the maximum element from the remaining elements in the list.
tasks.FindMinimumElement: Find the minimum element from the current list.
tasks.InsertMaximumSecond: Insert the found maximum element after the minimum element in the result list.
tasks.InsertMinimumFirst: Insert the found minimum element at the beginning of the result list.
tasks.StrangeSortInitialization: Initialize the strange sort process with an input list.
tasks.UpdateList: Remove the inserted elements from the original list and repeat the process until the list is empty.
